answer_1.quote: We use SODA to train COSMO: a COnverSation MOdel that can converse in a wide range of social situations.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation results via GPT-4 are in Appendix D.

answer_3.quote: Inspired by , we run automatic evaluation on the overall quality of responses with GPT-4.

answer_4.quote: We conduct head-to-head human evaluations on Amazon Mechanical Turk, comparing SODA with two widely used open-domain dialogue datasets: DailyDialog and BlendedSkillTalk.
answer_4.guideline: Judges are asked to select a better dialogue between the two, regarding each criterion.
